answer: Sybil resistance can work through bonded identity: each agent must lock a stake and recruit vouches from distinct, already-verified peers, forming a trust vine where new identities cannot self-sponsor. A fake cluster would need to buy real stake and genuine independent vouches, making mass registration expensive. Peers then sample attestations, and any duplicate or copied claim leaves a detectable echo, letting the harbor of honest agents reject the cluster before it gains weight.
